requirement_text: When assessing non-German qualifications, Heidelberg University applies the evaluation framework provided by the Central Office for Foreign Education (Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen, ZAB). requirement_text: Die Bewerbung in das erste Fachsemester erfolgt in einem zweistufigen Verfahren (zwei Schritte): Neben der Bewerbung um einen Studienplatz an der Universität Heidelberg muss ein Antrag auf Ausstellung einer so genannten Vorprüfungsdokumentation bei uni-assist e.V. in Berlin gestellt werden. Die Ausstellung einer Vorprüfungsdokumentation ist auch dann nötig, wenn Sie mit Ihrer Bewerbung um einen Platz im Fachstudium die Aufnahme in einen Deutschkurs oder in das Studienkolleg beantragen. Ohne die Vorprüfungsdokumentation kann die Bewerbung um einen Studienplatz an der Universität Heidelberg nicht berücksichtigt werden.

researcher_notes:
English translation: 'Application for the first subject-semester takes place in a two-step procedure: alongside applying for a place at Heidelberg University, an application for a so-called Vorprüfungsdokumentation (preliminary examination documentation) must be filed with uni-assist e.V. in Berlin. ... Without the Vorprüfungsdokumentation, the application for a place at Heidelberg University cannot be considered.' Conflicts with HEI0010, a currently-live page for the same applicant group that does not mention uni-assist at all. Both recorded per the evidence-conflict rule — neither is silently chosen. Recommend a follow-up fetch of a currently-dated (2026-cycle) Medicine/Pharmacy/Dentistry non-EU applicant procedure page before this gates a live requirement check. Document also lists further required items for this same applicant group: TestAS result (HEI0011), APS certificate for Mongolia/Vietnam/PR China applicants (HEI0012), and a personal motivation letter (HEI0013).

RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/11-heidelberg-uniassist-medicine.md): UNRESOLVED — both readings stand, neither is settled fact. No current dated source states the procedure: the evidence is two stale Heidelberg PDFs saying uni-assist is mandatory and one undated live faculty page saying apply directly. IMPORTANT NEAR-MISS, recorded because the research path was entirely plausible: search results asserted the uni-assist step is current 2026 guidance with a 1 July winter-semester deadline. The document behind that claim is Heidelberg's own PDF at /md/studium/interesse/int_bewerbung/verfahren/uniassist_engl.pdf, whose title page reads 'for the winter semester 2011/12' with deadlines 'July 1st, 2011' — a fifteen-year-old file, still live on the official domain, paraphrased by a search engine in the present tense. Accepting it would have produced a WRONG RESOLUTION published as truth. Search discovers; fetch verifies; and verification means reading the document's own date, not the summary's tense. Two candidate central Heidelberg URLs returned HTTP 404. NOTE THE DIRECTION: a recency heuristic would prefer the modern-looking faculty page, while such substantive evidence as exists leans the other way — this is the Groningen-direction counterexample, sitting in the same corpus as Erasmus pointing the opposite way. STAKES ARE ASYMMETRIC: if uni-assist is required and a student applies directly, the application is not considered AT ALL, so the product must not present direct application as sufficient. Resolution route: Heidelberg's current Zulassungssatzung, uni-assist's member-university listing, or the International Students Office. SIDE-FINDING: at least two obsolete procedural PDFs (2011/12 and 2018/19) remain live on uni-heidelberg.de with no superseding notice and should be added to a known-stale ingestion exclusion list. This 2018/19 PDF was not itself re-fetched on 2026-08-22, so retrieved_at is unchanged. Its associated requirements HEI0011 (TestAS), HEI0012 (APS certificate) and HEI0013 (motivation letter) derive from the same document and inherit this unresolved state.
